title: Autosense calculates duplicated entries
body:
2.8.2 (bug was present in v2.3 and v2.6 as reported here https://github.com/MilosKozak/AndroidAPS/issues/1897)

Autosense is taking dupes into account for a long period. After a forced restart the dupes are gone.

Bg source is xDrip with G6.

![Screenshot_20210523-091256__01__01__01__01](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28272471/119252423-73699380-bbac-11eb-9cd4-d2c25f6bb159.jpg)

comments.body:
Just happened today again. 15 mins ago all was fine. Autosense on 1.0 and no duplicates. I check now and autosense is on 1,85 / 1,15 with all duplicate values.

Makes me uncertain to use Autosense any longer
this issue is rare and AAPS recover from it itself usually. So far I was not able to locate the issue because it's rare and not permanent. I found out it's related to some irregularity in bg data

I have the exact same issue.  I do not find that AAPS recovers from this by itself - a forced restart of the phone is required. The issue then usually returns within a few hours.  My BG source is G6 plus xDrip
restest with 3.0 and create new issue if needed
